sections.title: Computer Science and Design Major Credit Requirement
heading_path: Computer Science and Design Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: 96 SH are required in the major.

overview_text: The combined major in computer science and design integrates fundamental design courses with a strong programming foundation. Students will declare a concentration in interaction design, graphic and information design, or experience design. Students in this major often have an interest in human-centered design methods used in developing digital interfaces and applications.
